title: Deck Building
shortDescription: Custom-built decks in cedar, composite, or pressure-treated wood — engineered for Ontario winters with 4-ft frost-line footings and a 5-year workmanship warranty.
fullDescription: Transform your backyard into a premium outdoor living space with a custom-built deck designed for beauty and durability. We design each deck around your home's architecture and how you actually live — entertaining, dining, hot tubs, multi-level layouts with built-in benches and planters. Every deck is engineered to exceed local building codes with 4-foot minimum frost-line footings, premium-grade lumber, galvanized fasteners, and properly sized joists and ledger boards. Choose pressure-treated for value, Western Red Cedar for natural beauty, or composite (Trex/TimberTech) for zero maintenance.
features: Custom design to fit your home and lifestyle
Pressure-treated, Western Red Cedar, or composite
4 ft minimum frost-line footings
Galvanized fasteners + reinforced ledger boards
Built-in railings, stairs, and planters available
Built to exceed Ontario building code

finishes.name: Western Red Cedar
finishes.description: Premium natural decking with the timeless beauty of real wood. Naturally resistant to rot and insects, with a beautiful grain that ages to a silvery patina or stays warm with annual staining.

finishes.name: Composite (Trex / TimberTech)
finishes.description: Zero maintenance, never rots, never needs staining. Capped composite boards resist scratches, fading, and stains — backed by 25-year manufacturer warranties.

title: Deck Restoration
shortDescription: Don't replace it — restore it. Professional pressure washing, sanding, structural repairs, and premium staining bring a tired deck back to life for a fraction of the cost.
fullDescription: A weathered, graying deck doesn't have to mean a teardown. Our restoration process starts with professional-grade pressure washing to strip away years of mold, mildew, and dirt. We sand high-traffic areas to remove splinters, replace any rotted boards, tighten loose railings, and finish with premium UV-stable stain for protection against harsh Canadian winters. Most decks look brand new for a fraction of the cost of replacement — and the new finish typically lasts 3 to 5 years before re-application.
features: Deep pressure-wash to remove mold and graying
Sand high-traffic areas to remove splinters
Replace rotted boards + tighten loose railings
Premium weather-resistant UV-stable stain
Structural safety inspection on every job
Most projects completed in 2 to 3 days

title: Vinyl Fences
shortDescription: Durable, maintenance-free privacy that looks brand new for decades — no paint, no stain, no rot. Built with steel-reinforced posts set 4 ft deep.
fullDescription: Vinyl fencing delivers the look of a freshly painted white wood fence — but without any of the maintenance. UV-stabilized PVC won't warp, rot, peel, or fade. Our vinyl fences use steel-reinforced posts set in concrete a minimum of 4 feet deep to beat Ontario frost heave, and tongue-and-groove panels that lock together for solid privacy. Available in classic white, almond, or grey, with privacy, semi-private, and picket styles.
features: UV-stabilized PVC — won't fade or yellow
Steel-reinforced posts set 4 ft deep in concrete
Tongue-and-groove privacy panels
Lifetime manufacturer warranty on materials
Available in white, almond, and grey
Privacy, semi-private, picket, and ranch styles

title: Wood Fences
shortDescription: Professional, long-lasting pressure-treated and cedar fencing in classic picket, board-on-board, and modern horizontal styles — built for maximum privacy and durability.
fullDescription: The timeless look of real wood, built to last. We construct wood fences using premium pressure-treated lumber or naturally rot-resistant Western Red Cedar, with heavy-duty posts set a minimum of 4 feet deep in concrete. Choose from classic picket, solid board-on-board for maximum privacy, lattice-top for partial sight lines, or horizontal modern designs. All fasteners are hot-dipped galvanized or stainless to handle Ontario weather without rust streaks.
features: Pressure-treated or Western Red Cedar lumber
Heavy-duty 4×4 or 6×6 posts set 4 ft deep
Classic picket, board-on-board, or horizontal modern
Hot-dipped galvanized or stainless fasteners
Optional lattice tops, post caps, and decorative trims
Can be stained or painted to your colour

title: Steel Decorative Fences
shortDescription: Elegant powder-coated steel fencing that combines maximum security with timeless curb appeal — zero maintenance, lifetime durability.
fullDescription: Ornamental steel fencing brings the look of historic wrought iron with none of the rust or maintenance. Our powder-coated steel panels resist peeling, fading, and corrosion for decades. Choose classic spear-top, flat-top, or decorative ring styles, in standard black or custom colours. Steel fences are ideal for front-yard accents, pool enclosures (we follow Ontario pool fence regulations), and any property that needs strength plus style.
features: Powder-coated for rust + UV resistance
Spear-top, flat-top, or decorative ring designs
Pool-code compliant configurations
Self-closing, self-latching pool gates available
Custom colours beyond standard black
Decades of lifetime with zero maintenance

title: Chain-Link Fences
shortDescription: Affordable, high-security chain-link fencing in galvanized or vinyl-coated steel — perfect for dog runs, backyards, and commercial property boundaries.
fullDescription: Chain-link is the most cost-effective way to secure a property without blocking sightlines. We install galvanized steel or vinyl-coated (black or green) chain-link with heavy-gauge posts set 4 feet deep, top rails for strength, and your choice of mesh size (2" standard, 1¾" for small dogs). Ideal for dog runs, garden enclosures, kids' play areas, commercial yards, and backyards that need security without the cost of a privacy fence.
features: Galvanized or vinyl-coated (black/green) finish
Heavy-gauge steel posts set 4 ft deep
2" mesh standard, 1¾" available for small pets
Top rail + tension wire for long-term tightness
Walk gates + drive gates available
Heights from 4 ft to 8 ft
